playbook.notes: Version 2 = the shipped version 1 (its seven cast rules unchanged and in their order, now rules 6 to 12; no triggers, no attack block, so Forge attacks, as shipped) with six rules for the deck's answers: rules 1 to 5 in front, rule 13 at the end. Written from the seat's 200 games of the league of twelve (league-run #3, seed 20261250), where it won 57. Seen / cast in / in hand at the last own turn of a loss: Volcanic Torrent 80 / 37 / 25, Curse of the Swine 82 / 0 / 36 (AI:RemoveDeck:All, Forge never casts it), Baral's Expertise 85 / 59 / 16, Propaganda 88 / 77 / 1 (in hand a median of two own turns first), Pongify 89 / 82 / 5, Chaos Warp 83 / 77 / 5, Vandalblast 80 / 73 / 10, Arcane Denial 74 / 46 / 11. Forge already plays the instants (Pongify, Chaos Warp) and Vandalblast; the losses were held with the sorcery wipes. Rule 1: Volcanic Torrent (one-sided: X damage to each creature and planeswalker the opponents control, X = spells we cast this turn, cascade adds one) once two spells have gone this turn and an opponent has four creatures, so X is at least four. Rule 2: Torrent at once against an opponent with eight creatures, where even X of two clears a token board (the pool is token decks: Goblin, Soldier, Elf, Zombie, Drake tokens). Rule 13: Torrent with whatever mana the engine rules leave, against four creatures. Local casts (16 tables of bots, seeds 20263050-51): five from hand, killing 10 tokens; a planeswalker and three Boars; 12 creatures (storm 16); Cid and eight Soldiers. Rule 3: Curse of the Swine when an opponent could hit for 12 and no opponent has more than six creatures: X and the targets are Forge's (its ChangeZone logic agrees once the flag is bypassed), and against a wide board it spread X over 1/1 tokens (which become 2/2 Boars) and a ward creature whose ward countered the whole spell (first local batch, under 'threat >= 12' alone); the cap of six keeps it for boards of few large creatures, which is where trading a creature for a 2/2 helps. Cast twice locally; one resolved, three creatures exiled. Rule 4: Baral's Expertise when an opponent could kill us next turn (bounce three, targets Forge's). Rule 5: Propaganda as soon as an opponent has three creatures, ahead of the engine (it was the last card of the shipped payoff list). Not expressible: Arcane Denial (a counterspell needs a spell on the stack, other players' turns), Pongify and Chaos Warp at instant speed or aimed at a chosen permanent of an opponent (left to Forge, which casts them in nine games of ten), Vandalblast's overload (an alternative cost, which play rules do not use), the targets and X of Curse of the Swine. Shipped as version 2 on 2026-11-14 from ab-run #31: on the same 200 tables of bots (seed 20261300, opponents drawn from the other eleven bots under their playbooks of 2026-11-13) it won 58 against version 1's 59 (-0.5 points, 95% -6 to +5, exact test 1.0); the cards the new rules name were cast in 155 of the 211 games they were drawn, under version 1 in 69 of 209. It has not been set against its stock pilot. What it still casts in a share of games 15 points or more below stock AI's (the stock arm of ab-run #26, other tables of the same pool), 9 cards: Elemental Eruption, Rousing Refrain, Galvanic Iteration, Pyretic Charge, Deep Analysis, Arcane Denial and 3 more (demo-data/playtest/2026-11-14/pool-answers/quick-draw-check.txt).
